title: Speech voices
description: The voices a text-to-speech service offers, for a publisher whose API does not list them.

source.description: The publisher's documentation page the list comes from.

checked.description: The date the list was last compared with the source, YYYY-MM-DD.

id.description: The name a request sends. Unique in the file.

models.description: The only models the voice works with; absent when it works with every model of the call.

languages.description: BCP 47 tags the voice speaks; absent when the publisher names none.

source.description: A page for this voice when it differs from the file's source.
